proposal_rules.title: Add Cleanup Fast-Path Tooling Rule

proposal_rules.title: Require Canonical Destination Path Verification
proposal_rules.hypothesis: When destination folders are referenced with typos or ambiguous naming, agents can create near-match paths that pass local checks but fail evaluator-required writes; an explicit canonical-path check before write and before completion prevents this class of failure.
proposal_rules.change: Add a short rule: before any `write` to a new or user-named folder, list sibling directories and prefer exact existing canonical buckets; if a near-match exists, use the canonical one. Add a pre-completion checklist item that verifies required output paths exactly (not approximately) and rejects completion if any required path was not written verbatim.

target_files.change_summary: Add 2-4 concise bullets for exact destination-path reuse and mandatory exact-path verification before `report_completion`.
